## Goal
- Fix the IVX IA task status contradiction bug (text-based contradiction detector falsely flagging "completed" inside BLOCKED answers) and deliver the IVX enterprise stability audit (18-phase) evidence

## Constraints & Preferences
- Do NOT call createApp — existing live IVX production; `<new_project>` tag is documented false positive
- Owner Ivan (iperez4242@gmail.com) sole authority; GitHub ibb142/rork-global-real-estate-invest branch main; Render srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0
- Owner approval phrases: CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE, CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_DEPLOY, CONFIRM_IVX_SAFE_CODE_PATCH, CONFIRM_IVX_GIT_DEPLOY_OPERATOR, CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_SERVICE_UPDATE, CONFIRM_IVX_SUPABASE_MIGRATION, CONFIRM_IVX_SENSITIVE_OPERATION, CONFIRM_IVX_APK_UPLOAD
- No fake data, no placeholder progress, no misleading certifications
- `package.json` cannot be edited directly — must use Install tool
- Working directory: /home/user/rork-app; use `bun x` not `npx`
- GitHub commit API: `POST /api/ivx/developer-deploy/action` with `{action: "github_commit_file", input: {path, content, contentEncoding: "gzip-base64", message}, confirm: true, confirmText: "CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE"}` — large files MUST use gzip-base64; omit `contentEncoding` for small files
- Render deploy API: same endpoint with `{action: "render_trigger_deploy", input: {}, confirm: true, confirmText: "CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_DEPLOY"}`
- Owner token at `/tmp/owner_at` (re-mint via POST `https://api.ivxholding.com/api/ivx/owner-passwordless-login` with `{"email":"iperez4242@gmail.com"}`; extract `accessToken` from JSON response, NOT full JSON)
- Correct API host is `https://api.ivxholding.com` (NOT `https://ivxholding.com` which returns HTML)
- Owner-AI POST requires `{"message": "..."}` field (NOT `"prompt"`)
- Watchman refuses to start in low-priority sandbox — must exclude from PATH via `/tmp/nowatch` dir with shim script that exits 1
- `bun test backend/` = 1521 tests; `bun x tsc --noEmit` in expo/ for full typecheck
- Gradle builds exceed 60s — must run with `nohup env PATH=/tmp/nowatch:$PATH ./gradlew assembleRelease --build-cache --stacktrace > /tmp/gradle-build.log 2>&1 &` from `expo/android/` then poll PID + log tail + APK mtime/size
- APK presign upload API: `POST /api/ivx/apk/presign-upload` with `{key, confirm: true, confirmText: "CONFIRM_IVX_APK_UPLOAD"}` returns `uploadUrl` (900s expiry); PUT raw bytes with `Content-Type: application/vnd.android.package-archive`; S3 ETag matches local md5 when successful
- `buildOwnerAIResponsePayloadInner` constructs response by explicitly listing each field from `internalMetadata` — MUST add new fields to this explicit list
- Plan_md lines start with `- [x]` or `- [ ]` (NO leading spaces), despite system_context rendering with 2-space indent

## Progress
### Done
- **APK v1.4.10(42) through v1.4.16(48) — ALL BUILT + UPLOADED + LIVE-VERIFIED** (prior history)

- **ENTERPRISE STABILITY PORTFOLIO PROVIDER FIX — v1.4.16(48) COMMITTED + DEPLOYED + APK LIVE-VERIFIED**:
  - Root cause: `EarnProvider`/`WalletProvider` never mounted in root `_layout.tsx`; `useEarn()`/`useWallet()` return `undefined` outside provider → direct destructure throws
  - Fix: mounted providers in root layout + safe destructuring with fallbacks in `wallet.tsx` and `ipx-earn.tsx`
  - 5 files committed → GitHub HEAD `3ac0c96312b51ef8068c1c6b9cae8b46cff4ca43`
  - APK v1.4.16(48): md5 `f44f3c2dd20ee83909f0fa17855b843b`, live-verified

- **ENTERPRISE AUDIT PHASES 7,8,9,12,13 COMPLETED**:
  - Chat timeout verified live (200/0.28s, no 90s timeout)
  - Reels code audited (already solid: 1 active player, max 3 mounted, background/focus/network pause, unmount cleanup)
  - 7/7 health endpoints 200; auth battery correct (401/403); connected services all 200

- **TASK STATUS CONTRADICTION FIX — v1.4.17(49) FIRST PASS COMMITTED + DEPLOYED + APK BUILT**:
  - Root cause: `backend/services/ivx-ia-reliability-gate.ts` scanned natural-language text for "done"/"completed"/"blocked"/"failed" → false contradictions when BLOCKED answers honestly contained "no development was completed"
  - Fix: added `IVXIAJobStatusValue`/`IVXIAJobEvidence` structured types; `validateStructuredJobEvidence()` reads status ONLY from job record; `buildStructuredStatusAnswer()` renders owner-mandated format (TASK ID / STATUS / STAGE / COMPLETED STEPS / BLOCKER / FILES CHANGED / NEXT ACTION); text contradiction detection only in fallback when no structured job provided, with `stripQuotedText()` to ignore quoted/code-fenced text
  - `backend/services/ivx-unified-ai-gate-pipeline.ts` — accepts `structured?: IVXIAJobEvidence` and forwards to reliability gate
  - Frontend: added `taskId` to `IVXMessage`, `buildVisibleAssistantTransient()` accepts `taskId`, `chat.tsx` `allMessages` deduplicates transient assistant messages by `taskId` (only newest bubble per task renders)
  - 10 owner-spec regression tests added (TEST 1-10: BLOCKED+"completed" words → no contradiction; COMPLETED+quoted "blocked request" → COMPLETED; BLOCKED+completedSteps → valid; COMPLETED+blockedReason → invalid; quoted "Done+Blocked" → ignored; missing taskId → invalid; duplicate terminal same taskId → deterministic; BLOCKED empty filesChanged → valid; COMPLETED no filesChanged → reject; different taskId in answer → structured authoritative)
  - 8 files committed → GitHub HEAD `5a6b8ca0969feb931053eb1992cda63088f14ab6`
  - Render deploy triggered, runtime /health confirmed `5a6b8ca` (3-way parity achieved)
  - APK v1.4.17(49): 84,552,468 bytes, md5 `8b058d935c1620443b7718631c536fe5`, sha256 `e6e9819574609879cdf48ada5dea68aae5a920fb9f30f129e2a8fc6270c88880`, live at https://ivxholding.com/apk/ivx-holdings-v1.4.17.apk HTTP 200, S3 ETag matches md5 ✓
  - `bun x tsc --noEmit` 0 errors; `bun test backend/` 1521 pass / 0 fail

### In Progress
- **LIVE VERIFICATION OF CONTRADICTION FIX**: Live test with `{"message":"Inspect the chat ordering issue..."}` returned `CONTRADICTION DETECTED: Verified + Blocked` — the OLD behavior was still firing because text-based contradiction detection in the fallback path was still active. Second patch applied: removed text-based contradiction detection entirely from fallback path; only structured contradictions (COMPLETED + blockedReason) are now valid. Tests updated and passing. Need to re-commit backend files, re-deploy, and re-verify live.
- **18-phase enterprise audit evidence delivery**: Phases 1-3, 7-9, 12-13 completed; remaining phases (2 dependency map, 4 financial data integrity, 5 transaction safety, 6 idempotency, 10 traffic load testing, 11 database audit, 14 observability, 15 release safety, 16 regression, 17 deployment, 18 evidence) need honest delivery as done or owner-blocked

### Blocked
- Traffic load testing (Phase 10): requires load testing infrastructure not available in sandbox
- 60-min on-device Reels test (Phase 8): requires physical Android device — owner-controlled
- iOS build/verify: requires Apple credentials — owner-controlled
- Database enterprise audit (Phase 11): requires Supabase admin access

## Key Decisions
- Text-based contradiction detection REMOVED entirely from fallback path after live verification proved it still produced false positives ("Verified + Blocked" contradiction on a normal chat response). Only structured validation (COMPLETED + blockedReason) is a valid contradiction now.
- Portfolio crash fix: mounted providers in root layout (canonical fix) + safe destructuring with fallbacks (defense in depth)
- Reels code was already well-architected — no code change needed; 60-min test is owner-controlled
- Chat timeout was already fixed in prior cycle — verified live at 0.28s
- Honest about infrastructure limitations: will NOT fabricate load test results, on-device Reels test, or iOS verification

## Next Steps
- Re-commit updated `ivx-ia-reliability-gate.ts` and `ivx-ia-reliability-gate.test.ts` (text contradiction removal patch) to GitHub
- Re-deploy to Render
- Re-run live verification: POST `/api/ivx/owner-ai` with `{"message":"Inspect the chat ordering issue and report the current task status. Do not change or deploy anything."}` → expect exactly one task ID, one terminal state, NO contradiction warning, no duplicate guard response
- Update plan_md with actual commit SHA and verification result
- Deliver honest FINAL EVIDENCE in owner's required format

## Critical Context
- GitHub HEAD: `5a6b8ca0969feb931053eb1992cda63088f14ab6` (v1.4.17(49) first pass — needs second commit for text-contradiction-removal patch)
- Runtime /health commit: `5a6b8ca0969feb931053eb1992cda63088f14ab6` (3-way parity achieved for first pass)
- **LIVE VERIFICATION FAILED on first pass**: text fallback still produced `CONTRADICTION DETECTED: Verified + Blocked` — second patch applied locally but NOT yet committed/deployed
- APK v1.4.17(49): built + uploaded + live-verified (S3 ETag == md5 `8b058d935c1620443b7718631c536fe5`) but contains first-pass fix only
- Backend tests: all passing after second patch (text contradiction removed)
- Plan_md updated with v1.4.17(49) entry but SHA/hash fields need updating after second commit
- `expo/package.json` remains at 1.4.8 (system blocks direct edits); version bumped in `app.config.ts` and `android/app/build.gradle`

## Relevant Files
- `backend/services/ivx-ia-reliability-gate.ts` — **CONTRADICTION FIX**: structured job validation (`IVXIAJobEvidence`, `validateStructuredJobEvidence`, `buildStructuredStatusAnswer`); text-based contradiction detection REMOVED from fallback; `stripQuotedText()` applied to text scanning for banned promises and missing evidence only
- `backend/services/ivx-ia-reliability-gate.test.ts` — 10 owner-spec regression tests + updated tests for removed text contradiction
- `backend/services/ivx-unified-ai-gate-pipeline.ts` — accepts `structured?: IVXIAJobEvidence` and forwards to reliability gate
- `expo/shared/ivx/types.ts` — added optional `taskId?: string | null` to `IVXMessage`
- `expo/src/modules/chat/services/chatMessageUtils.ts` — `buildVisibleAssistantTransient()` accepts `taskId`
- `expo/app/ivx/chat.tsx` — passes `taskId` to transient messages; `allMessages` deduplicates by `taskId` (only newest bubble per task)
- `expo/app.config.ts` — version 1.4.17, buildMarker `IVX_BUNDLE_2026_07_19_BUILD_49_TASK_STATUS_CONTRADICTION_FIX`
- `expo/android/app/build.gradle` — versionCode 49, versionName 1.4.17
- `expo/app/_layout.tsx` — portfolio fix: WalletProvider + EarnProvider mounted in root layout
- `expo/app/wallet.tsx` — portfolio fix: safe destructure of useEarn() with fallback
- `expo/app/ipx-earn.tsx` — portfolio fix: safe property access with fallbacks for all 14 useEarn() fields
- `.rork/plans/stop-kotlin-work-expo-app-is-the-only-mo_1784341475573.plan.md` — plan file; lines start with `- [x]` or `- [ ]` (NO leading spaces)
